section_header: EMISSION CONTROL SYSTEMS — Three-Way Catalyst (TWC) System
title: THREE-WAY CATALYST (TWC) SYSTEM

content.description: Schematic diagram of Three-Way Catalyst (TWC) System showing exhaust flow from engine through catalytic converter to exhaust output. Shows NOx, CO, HC entering from engine, passing through three-way catalyst (monolithic), and outputting CO2, N2, H2O

content.text: To reduce HC, CO and NOx emissions, they are oxidized, reduced and converted to nitrogen (N2), carbon dioxide (CO2) and water (H2O) by the catalyst.
